- #1 **Bottom taskbar for window switching.** The minimal openbox desktop had no panel, so JDownloader's window, its dialogs and the optional captcha browser could slip behind one another with no easy way back. This release adds a thin dark taskbar along the bottom that lists every open window; click one to bring it to the front (Alt+Tab still cycles windows too, and middle-clicking the empty desktop shows a full window list). It is built on tint2 (about 1 MB), themed to match the Carbon dark UI. This is the same taskbar rolled out to the krusader container. There is no system tray, so a normal minimize goes to the taskbar rather than disappearing.
